title: hieracium chondrillifolium subsp. calcicola
intro: Hieracium chondrillifolium subsp. calcicola, commonly known as a rare subspecies of Hawkweed, is a flowering plant in the dandelion family (Asteraceae). It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties that may help to reduce inflammation and protect against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds that are thought to contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects. Additionally, Hieracium chondrillifolium subsp. calcicola has been traditionally used to treat various ailments, including digestive issues and skin problems.
